answer: No. Your dad doesn't need a notary in Virginia. Northwind now uses power of attorney form NW-POA-2, which he can sign electronically. Only Georgia still requires a notary for a power of attorney. One of our help articles still says to have form NW-POA-1 notarized, but that form has been retired. NW-POA-2 replaced it on February 1, 2026, and a signed NW-POA-1 was only accepted until June 30, 2026. Bring the signed NW-POA-2, your own photo ID and the car's documents. A power of attorney ends if the person who signed it dies.
